16609-life-of-lord-byron-vol-5-with-his-.creator: Unknown

You have got a new Bourbon, it seems, whom they have  christened 'Dieu-donné;'--perhaps the honour of the present may be  disputed. Did you write the good lines on ----, the Laker?

52167-an-earthman-on-venus-originally-ti.title: {_Originally titled “THE RADIO MAN”_}
52167-an-earthman-on-venus-originally-ti.creator: Ralph Milne Farley
52167-an-earthman-on-venus-originally-ti.description: A book by Ralph Milne Farley. the suave scoundrel who wouldn’t hesitate to sell out his whole  race to get Lilla’s hand by force. TORON, who tipped Myles off to Lilla’s private intentions in order to  save himself from slavery. BTHUH, the beautiful lady who conspired to win Myles for herself,  though she had to help his deadliest enemies to do it.

68308-the-mexican-war-diary-of-george-b-.title: The Mexican War Diary Of George B Mcclellan
68308-the-mexican-war-diary-of-george-b-.creator: Unknown
68308-the-mexican-war-diary-of-george-b-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ill might rest upon the shoulders of certain politicians and generals hitherto adjudged to be “great.” On the other hand, if McClellan was in the right, and the present writer believes that in large part he was, then he was a victim of envy and downright falsehood. His name should now be cleared of all unjust accusations, and also history should reverse its judgment of many of his opponents.

71914-the-inalienable-heritage-and-other.title: And Other Poems
71914-the-inalienable-heritage-and-other.creator: Emily Lawless, Litt.D.
71914-the-inalienable-heritage-and-other.description: A book by Emily Lawless, Litt.D.. cious phrase.” There are words, fragments, that run in our heads and make us wonder from which great poet they come, until we remember they are hers. They generally recall the Elizabethans, and the verse of the Elizabethans it was whose poetry most affected and most influenced her.

arxiv-1803-10136.title: Comprehending Real Numbers: Development of Bengali Real Number Speech Corpus
arxiv-1803-10136.creator: Md Mahadi Hasan Nahid, Md. Ashraful Islam, Bishwajit Purkaystha, Md Saiful Islam
arxiv-1803-10136.description: Abstract Speech recognition has received a less attention in Bengali literature due to the lack of a comprehensive dataset. In this paper, we describe the development process of the first comprehensive Bengali speech dataset on real numbers. It comprehends all the possible words that may arise in uttering any Bengali real number.

arxiv-2002-09853.title: Optimizing Traffic Lights with Multi-agent Deep Reinforcement Learning and V2X communication
arxiv-2002-09853.creator: Azhar Hussain, Tong Wang, Cao Jiahua College of Information, Communication Engineering, Harbin Engineering University, 150001, Harbin, China engrazr@hrbeu.edu.cn
arxiv-2002-09853.description: Abstract We consider a system to optimize duration of traffic signals using multi-agent deep reinforcement learning and Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication. This system aims at analyzing independent and shared rewards for multi-agents to control duration of traffic lights. A learning agent traffic light gets information along its lanes within a circular V2X coverage.

arxiv-2111-00543.title: A modular construction of type theories
arxiv-2111-00543.creator: Frédéric Blanqui ORCID:0000-0001-7438-5554, Gilles Dowek ORCID:0000-0001-6253-935X, Emilie Grienenberger, Gabriel Hondet, François Thiré
arxiv-2111-00543.description: Abstract . The λ ​ Π \lambda\Pi -calculus modulo theory is a logical framework in which many type systems can be expressed as theories. We present such a theory, the theory 𝒰 {\mathcal{U}} , where proofs of several logical systems can be expressed.

arxiv-2203-08004.title: Localization, multifractality, and many-body localization in periodically kicked quasiperiodic lattices
arxiv-2203-08004.creator: Yu Zhang, Bozhen Zhou, Haiping Hu, Shu Chen
arxiv-2203-08004.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yu Zhang, Bozhen Zhou, Haiping Hu, Shu Chen. We study the combined effect of quasiperiodic disorder, driven and interaction in the periodically kicked Aubry-André model. In the non-interacting limit, by analyzing the quasienergy spectrum statistics, we verify the existence of a dynamical localization transition in the high-frequency region, whereas the spectrum statistics becomes intricate in the low-frequency region due to the emergence of the extended/localized-to-multifractal edges in the quasienergy spectrum, which separate the multifractal states from the extended (localized) states.

arxiv-2209-06691.title: Certified Robustness to Word Substitution Ranking Attack for Neural Ranking Models Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; October 17–21, 2022; Atlanta, GA, USA Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Information and K
arxiv-2209-06691.creator: Chen Wu, Ruqing Zhang, Jiafeng Guo, Wei Chen, Yixing Fan, Maarten de Rijke, Xueqi Cheng
arxiv-2209-06691.description: Abstract . Neural ranking models (NRMs) have achieved promising results in information retrieval. NRMs have also been shown to be vulnerable to adversarial examples. A typical Word Substitution Ranking Attack (WSRA) against NRMs was proposed recently, in which an attacker promotes a target document in rankings by adding human-imperceptible perturbations to its text.

arxiv-2303-13867.title: Few Shot Medical Image Segmentation with Cross Attention Transformer
arxiv-2303-13867.creator: Yi Lin †, Yufan Chen †, Kwang-Ting Cheng, and Hao Chen 🖂
arxiv-2303-13867.description: Abstract Medical image segmentation has made significant progress in recent years. Deep learning-based methods are recognized as data-hungry techniques, requiring large amounts of data with manual annotations. However, manual annotation is expensive in the field of medical image analysis, which requires domain-specific expertise.

arxiv-2307-01082.title: Energy Beamforming for RF Wireless Power Transfer with Dynamic Metasurface Antennas
arxiv-2307-01082.creator: Amirhossein Azarbahram, Onel L. A. López, Richard D. Souza, Rui Zhang, and Matti Latva-Aho
arxiv-2307-01082.description: Abstract Radio frequency (RF) wireless power transfer (WPT) is a promising technology for charging the Internet of Things. Practical RF-WPT systems usually require energy beamforming (EB), which can compensate for the severe propagation loss by directing beams toward the devices. The EB flexibility depends on the transmitter architecture, existing a trade-off between cost/complexity and degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2403-10498.title: D ​ K / D ​ π DK/D\pi scattering and an exotic virtual bound state at the S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) flavour symmetric point from lattice QCD
arxiv-2403-10498.creator: J. Daniel E. Yeo, Christopher E. Thomas, David J. Wilson, (for the Hadron Spectrum Collaboration)
arxiv-2403-10498.description: Abstract Elastic S − S- wave scattering of a charm meson with a light pseudoscalar meson in J P = 0 + J^{P}=0^{+} is investigated in the flavour 𝟑 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{3}} , 𝟔 \mathbf{6} and 𝟏𝟓 ¯ \overline{\mathbf{15}} sectors at the S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) f SU(3)_{f} flavour point using lattice QCD, working on three volumes with

arxiv-2411-12563.title: Stream-Based Active Learning for Process Monitoring
arxiv-2411-12563.creator: Christian Capezza, Antonio Lepore, Kamran Paynabar
arxiv-2411-12563.description: Abstract Statistical process monitoring (SPM) methods are essential tools in quality management to check the stability of industrial processes, i.e., to dynamically classify the process state as in control (IC), under normal operating conditions, or out of control (OC), otherwise.

arxiv-2505-23811.title: LayerIF : Estimating Layer Quality for Large Language Models using Influence Functions
arxiv-2505-23811.creator: Hadi Askari, Shivanshu Gupta, Fei Wang, Anshuman Chhabra, Muhao Chen
arxiv-2505-23811.description: Abstract Pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a wide range of tasks, yet exhibit substantial variability in the various layers’ training quality with respect to specific downstream applications, limiting their downstream performance. It is therefore critical to estimate layer-wise training quality in a manner that accounts for both model architecture and training data.

arxiv-2507-05549.title: The Ethical Implications of AI in Creative Industries: A Focus on AI-Generated Art CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language generation CCS: Applied computing Media arts CCS: Applied computing Ethics CCS: Computing methodologies Cognitive science
arxiv-2507-05549.creator: Prerana Khatiwada, Joshua Washington, Tyler Walsh, Ahmed Saif Hamed, Lokesh Bhatta
arxiv-2507-05549.description: Abstract . As Artificial Intelligence (AI) continues to grow daily, more exciting (and somewhat controversial) technology emerges every other day. As we see the advancements in AI, we see more and more people becoming skeptical of it. This paper explores the complications and confusion around the ethics of generative AI art.

arxiv-2510-27220.title: Zitterbewegung Effect and Quantum Geometry in Non-Hermitian Exciton-Polariton Systems
arxiv-2510-27220.creator: Y.-M. Robin Hu, Elena A. Ostrovskaya, Eliezer Estrecho
arxiv-2510-27220.description: Abstract In this work, we analytically derive a semi-classical equation of motion describing the zitterbewegung effects arising in the dynamics of wavepackets in non-Hermitian systems. In Hermitian non-relativistic quantum systems, the zitterbewegung effects can arise due to the spin precession and spin-orbit coupling.

arxiv-2511-10317.title: A Dynamical Scalar Field Model for Dark Energy: Addressing the Hubble Tension and Cosmic Evolution
arxiv-2511-10317.creator: and Raka Dabhade
arxiv-2511-10317.description: Abstract We propose a dynamical dark energy model based on a canonical scalar field with a hybrid potential of the form V ⁡ ( ϕ ) = V 0 ​ e − λ ​ ϕ + V 1 ​ ϕ n V(\phi)=V_{0}e^{-\lambda\phi}+V_{1}\phi^{n} .

arxiv-2604-13678.creator: Jian-Feng Cai, Huiping Li, Jiayi Li

plaw-105-331-1998.creator: United States Congress
plaw-105-331-1998.description: Public Law 105-331 (1998): Thomas Alva Edison Commemorative Coin Act

pmc-10563045.title: Role of pharmacist in the management of Hansen's Disease: A scoping review
pmc-10563045.creator: Elza Cristina de Oliveira Duarte, Nathania Rodrigues Santiago, Marília Berlofa Visacri, Tácio de Mendonça Lima
pmc-10563045.description: BackgroundStakeholders and healthcare professionals have an essential role in the elimination of Hansen's Disease. Of these, pharmacists provide core services that assist the management of these patients with the supply of medicines and clinical actions.ObjectivesTo summarize evidence on the role of pharmacist in the management of Hansen's Disease.

pmc-11323367.title: A patient-derived amyotrophic lateral sclerosis blood-brain barrier model for focused ultrasound-mediated anti-TDP-43 antibody delivery
pmc-11323367.creator: Joanna M Wasielewska, Juliana C S Chaves, Mauricio Castro Cabral-da-Silva, Martina Pecoraro, Stephani J Viljoen, Tam Hong Nguyen, Vincenzo La Bella, Lotta E Oikari, Lezanne Ooi, Anthony R White
pmc-11323367.description: BackgroundAmyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a rapidly progressing neurodegenerative disorder with minimally effective treatment options. An important hurdle in ALS drug development is the non-invasive therapeutic access to the motor cortex currently limited by the presence of the blood-brain barrier (BBB).

pmc-11840556.title: Learning genotype–phenotype associations from gaps in multi-species sequence alignments
pmc-11840556.creator: Uwaise Ibna Islam, Andre Luiz Campelo dos Santos, Ria Kanjilal, Raquel Assis
pmc-11840556.description: Understanding the genetic basis of phenotypic variation is fundamental to biology. Here we introduce GAP, a novel machine learning framework for predicting binary phenotypes from gaps in multi-species sequence alignments. GAP employs a neural network to predict the presence or absence of phenotypes solely from alignment gaps, contrasting with existing tools that require additional and often inaccessible input data.

pmc-12430893.title: Development of a Dynamic Path Planning System for Autonomous Mobile Robots Using a Multi-Agent System Approach
pmc-12430893.creator: Bradley Fourie, Louis Louw, Günter Bitsch
pmc-12430893.description: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) are increasingly important in Industry 4.0 intralogistics but creating path planning systems that adapt to dynamic and uncertain Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS), especially managing conflicts among multiple AMRs with a need for scalable decentralised solutions, remains a significant challenge.

pmc-12749386.title: Dust air pollution and hospital visits for respiratory, cardiovascular, and eye diseases in Eastern Iran
pmc-12749386.creator: Mohsen Hamidian, Anis Jor, Khadije Rezaie Keikhaie, Afrooz Mazidimoradi, Zahra Shahabinia, Hamid Salehiniya
pmc-12749386.description: One of the most significant environmental concerns that has been spreading in recent years due to human interference and irrational use of natural resources is the phenomenon of dust. This study investigated the relationship between dust air pollution and the burden of daily hospital visits due to respiratory, cardiovascular, and eye diseases.

pmc-12770067.title: Therapeutic potential of metformin-based combination therapy in acute myeloid leukemia
pmc-12770067.creator: Mobina Nakhaei Shamahmood, Abolfazl Miri, Mohammad Javad Yousefi, Fatemeh Mezginejad
pmc-12770067.description: BackgroundAcute myeloid leukemia (AML) is the most prevalent form of acute leukemia. Despite great efforts, the overall prognosis for patients with AML remains poor, and the mortality rate due to relapse is also considerable. Consequently, the disease poses treatment challenges.

pmc-12975646.title: Effect of Social Support Reciprocity on Mental Health Status Among Community‐Dwelling Older Adults: A Cross‐Sectional Study of the Kashiwa Cohort Study
pmc-12975646.creator: Natsumi Hirose, Toshiaki Takahashi, Tomoki Tanaka, Bo‐Kyung Son, Weida Lyu, Katsuya Iijima, Gojiro Nakagami
pmc-12975646.description: Background and AimsReciprocity of informal social support is associated with improved mental health in older adults. While several studies have examined support provision or receipt separately, this study clarifies reciprocity's effect on mental health among older adults in Japanese urban areas.MethodsA 2014 survey targeted community‐dwelling adults aged ≥ 65 years in Kashiwa City, Chiba, Japan.

pmc-13023948.title: Data-Driven Operational Bounds of Transmembrane Pressure for Modelling and Digital Twin Development in Haemodialysis and Haemodiafiltration
pmc-13023948.creator: Alexandru Dinu, Mădălin Frunzete, Denis Mihailovschi
pmc-13023948.description: Transmembrane pressure (TMP) is a central state variable in haemodialysis (HD) and haemodiafiltration (HDF), governing ultrafiltration dynamics, convective transport, and membrane performance. Although dialysis devices specify high maximum allowable pressure limits derived from in vitro testing and mechanical safety margins, the effective operating pressure space encountered under routine clinical conditions remains insufficiently quantified from a systems engineering perspective.

pmc-13103282.title: Effect of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation Targeting Brain Regions Identified Through Voxel‐Based Morphometry on One‐Legged Standing Balance With Eyes Closed
pmc-13103282.creator: Hirona Takahashi, Yasuto Inukai, Kazuaki Nagasaka, Shota Miyaguchi, Noriko Sakurai, Naoki Kodama, Naofumi Otsuru, Hideaki Onishi
pmc-13103282.description: IntroductionVoxel‐based morphometry (VBM) is a neuroimaging technique for quantitative analysis of brain structure. Previous studies have reported an association between gray matter (GM) volume in specific brain regions and balance function. Anodal transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) enhances excitability beneath the stimulation site and facilitates motor function.

pmc-13152183.title: Richness and biogeography of Pteridoflora in montane forests of eastern Mexico
pmc-13152183.creator: J. Daniel Tejero-Díez, Perla V. Rodríguez-Sánchez, Raúl Contreras-Medina, Julio Cesar Ramírez-Martínez, Jonathan D. Amith, Leccinum J. García-Morales, Celia Sanginés-Franco, Isolda Luna-Vega, Marcela Pagano, Marcela Pagano, Marcela Pagano
pmc-13152183.description: This study compiles and updates the checklist of ferns and lycophytes from the Sierra Madre Oriental (SMOR), Mexico. We analyzed the distribution and richness of these groups of seedless vascular plants to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data. We reviewed information on these taxa from regional floristic studies, field explorations, and herbarium specimens.

pmc-13182216.title: Dithioketal Polymers Via Radical Polymerization of γ‐Dithiobutyrolactone
pmc-13182216.creator: Maksym Odnoroh, Oleksandr Ivanchenko, Asja A. Kroeger, Michelle L. Coote, Stéphane Mazières, Mathias Destarac
pmc-13182216.description: Polymers bearing in‐chain dithioketal groups are an emerging class of materials with specific properties like reactive oxygen species (ROS)‐responsiveness and vitrimer‐type behavior. Until now, these polymers have been exclusively produced by step‐growth polymerization or polyaddition; herein, we report the first chain polymerization leading to dithioketal polymers.

pmc-13210096.title: Polymer Nanoparticles in Medical Applications—Future Directions
pmc-13210096.creator: Barbara Zawidlak-Węgrzyńska, Joanna Rydz
pmc-13210096.description: Polymer-based nanoparticle systems have emerged as a versatile platform for advancing precision medicine by enabling controlled, targeted, and multifunctional drug delivery. This narrative review synthesizes recent progress in the design, functionalization, and clinical translation of polymer-based nanoparticles, with a focused scope on drug delivery, diagnostics, theranostics, nanosponges, and regenerative medicine.

pmc-13357177.title: Concordance study of bronchial biopsy tissues and matched bronchial brushing cytology specimens in driver gene detection of non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13357177.creator: Xiongfeng Li, Lexia Chen, Peijia Niu, Jing Wang, Xupeng Sun, Ning Lu, Yahan Weng
pmc-13357177.description: ObjectiveTo clarify the correlation between clinicopathological features and gene mutation status in bronchial biopsy tissues and matched bronchial brushing cytology specimens from patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with a focus on verifying the concordance of driver gene detection between the two types of specimens, so as to provide high-quality clinical evidence for specimen selection in gene testing for

pmc-13400309.title: Effects of exercise and liraglutide on vascular health and inflammation during weight loss maintenance: a prespecified secondary analysis of the S-LiTE trial
pmc-13400309.creator: Rasmus Michael Sandsdal, Joachim Holt, Haithem Ghalib Ali Alkhefagie, Julie Rehné Jørgensen, Christian Rimer Juhl, Lisa M Olsen, Sarah Byberg, Roopameera Thirumathyam, Lasse Gliemann, Bente Stallknecht, Jens Juul Holst, Jens Dahlgaard Hove, Thomas Bandholm, Kirstine Nyvold Bojsen-Møller, Sten Madsbad, Joachim Størling, Else Marie Bladbjerg, Charalambos Antoniades, Simon Birk Kjær Jensen, Signe Sørensen Torekov

pmc-13427856.title: Totally Endoscopic Sublay Anterior Repair (TESAR) for diastasis recti, primary and incisional ventral hernias: Long-term clinical outcomes and quality of life
pmc-13427856.creator: Federico Fiori, Francesco Ferrara, Carlo Corbellini, Lorenzo Gallitiello, Domenico Lo Conte, Marco Stella

pmc-13453381.title: A Host-Clinical Integrated Prediction Model for Early Sepsis Risk in Diabetic Patients with Acute Infections: Development and Internal Validation
pmc-13453381.creator: Xilong Pan, Zhiyuan Xu, ChanJuan Zhuo, Li Chen
pmc-13453381.description: ObjectiveDiabetic patients exhibit increased susceptibility to infections and a higher risk of progression to sepsis. This study aimed to develop a sepsis risk prediction model specifically for diabetic patients with acute infections.MethodsIn this retrospective, single-center study, we enrolled 604 hospitalized diabetic patients with acute infections. A propensity score-matched cohort (103 sepsis cases vs 412 non-sepsis controls) was constructed.

pmc-13576619.title: Single‐Cell Transcriptomics and Mendelian Randomization Analysis Reveal Key Genes in Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-13576619.creator: Xiangpeng Chen, Hongquan Chen, Shiguang Xu, Shumin Wang, Huishan Wang, Hao Meng
pmc-13576619.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) is one of the most common cardiac arrhythmias. It reduces quality of life and increases the risk of complications such as stroke. Although progress has been made in understanding its pathogenesis, the key cellular subtypes and therapeutic targets remain unclear.MethodsWe applied single‐cell transcriptomics to identify critical cellular subtypes in AF.

pmc-13604893.title: Targeted Regulation of Pancreatic Islet Function by Natural Products Against Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Advances and Prospects
pmc-13604893.creator: Guanrong Qiao, Oluwaniyi Isaiah Adejobi, Xuefang Li, Yaqin Yang, Xudong He, Li Li, Yue Zhou, Jiawei Li, Hao Li, Fan Zhang, Jie Yu
pmc-13604893.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a major global health challenge, with insulin resistance (IR) and islet dysfunction as its core pathophysiology. Current glucose-lowering agents, including insulin secretagogues, insulin sensitizers, DPP–IV inhibitors, SGLT-2 inhibitors, and GLP-1 receptor agonists, effectively control blood glucose and may partly improve β-cell function indirectly, but they do not directly target the functional defects of pancreatic β cells. Developing drugs that precisely modulate islet function is therefore a key direction.
